svg.title: Explicit execution planning and supported paths
svg.desc: An exact-shape table branches to measured configuration, conservative MMA default, or identity error. The caller passes configuration to a separate prepared-execution panel, which validates inputs, launches MMA/SIMT and returns output/carry. Unknown resource limits and future policy extensions are isolated and labeled.

text.tspan: No request-time benchmark; no universal small-batch threshold.
(b) PreparedSequence: validate, launch, preserve the selected contract
Explicit execution planning and supported paths
Generic forward | exact-shape offline policy | caller passes config to PreparedSequence
Explicit caller composition; PreparedSequence does not invoke ExecutionPolicy.
Preserve contract; qualify fallback or reject
